svg.title: Tea Cafe manager console — screen concepts
svg.desc: Nine manager views: dashboard, orders, payment review, products, product editor, finance, staff/settings, Telegram customers, and activity log.
svg.text: TEA CAFE · STAFF AND STORE MANAGER
One queue for orders, payments and the kitchen.
Admin web console concept · confirmation means staff checked the actual ABA receipt

g.text: A screenshot is evidence to review, never payment confirmation.
Select an order to review details and take the next action.
Check actual ABA incoming payment before confirming.
Changing a menu item never rewrites a placed order.
Amounts reflect staff-confirmed payments, not bank API reconciliation.
Only a manager can grant access or change payment settings.
Amber is review. Green appears after staff confirm.
A screenshot reply is visible to authorized group members.
Sample data only · confirm actual ABA receipt.
Customer details are visible to managers only.
Time · operator Telegram ID · source · before/after
Every action has a person and source.
Admin changes and group callbacks write
Screenshots reply to their matching order card.
A receipt is evidence; staff verifies ABA funds.

svg.text: A03 uses a second confirmation step. Staff checks the ABA transaction first; group screenshots are replies, not proof of payment.
